Trust in the process. Transparency at every step. Traceability from pickup to processing.

Mariinox is a privately owned vehicle-scrapping brand that manages a network of Registered Vehicle Scrapping Facilities (RVSFs). Every vehicle handled through Mariinox is processed by an RVSF authorised under the Motor Vehicles (Registration and Functions of Vehicle Scrapping Facility) Rules, 2021.

We manage the complete end-of-life vehicle scrapping journey from evaluation and doorstep pickup to payment, documentation coordination and processing. This enables vehicle owners to avoid the uncertainty of informal disposal and scrap their vehicles through a documented and legally compliant system.

Founded in 2023, by Sambhav Jain and Vipin Tokas, Mariinox is  present across 37 cities, including Delhi, Bengaluru, Lucknow, Varanasi, Ghaziabad, Kanpur and Roorkee. Headquartered in New Delhi, Mariinox is a bootstrapped enterprise serving individual vehicle owners, businesses and organisations seeking a responsible way to scrap their vehicles.

Our purpose goes beyond dismantling old vehicles. We are working to organise India’s vehicle-scrapping ecosystem by replacing uncertain and undocumented disposal with a process built on legal compliance and responsible material recovery.

Scrap legally. Close ownership responsibly.

TestMu AI provides an end-to-end Agentic testing platform to plan, author, execute, and analyze tests for web, mobile, and enterprise applications at scale, on real browsers, real devices, and custom real-world environments.

It includes:
- KaneAI: An AI-native testing agent that plans, authors, and evolves end-to-end tests in plain English across web and mobile.
- Kane CLI: A terminal-native command-line testing agent that verifies what you or coding agents built against requirements in a real browser.
- Agent Testing: Test chatbots, voice assistants, video agents, image analyzer agents, and phone caller agents for hallucinations, bias, and toxicity.
- Agent Assurance: Agentic testing for autonomous AI agents. It reads the agent's code, generates scenarios, and verifies actions through API and database checks.
- Real Device Cloud: Manual and automated testing across 10,000+ real Android and iOS devices.
- HyperExecute: An AI-native test orchestration platform that runs tests up to 70% faster than traditional cloud grids.
- Automation Cloud: Run Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, and Appium tests in parallel on 3,000+ browser-OS combinations and real devices.
- SmartUI: AI-native visual regression testing that captures and compares screenshots across browsers, devices, and resolutions, flagging real changes, not noise.
- Accessibility Testing: Identify and resolve WCAG and ADA issues across websites, web apps, and mobile apps.
- Browser Cloud: Browser infrastructure for AI agents: real Chrome sessions on demand for Claude, Cursor, and Gemini.
- Test Management: AI-native test management for manual and automated tests with two-way Jira sync.

Use 120+ integrations like Jira, GitHub, and Slack to accelerate testing across the entire software development lifecycle.

Visit our home page: www.testmuai.com
